[Pedagogy audit v2 · Unresolved possible error] The solution uses y+70°=180° for y, but the 70° angle is not co-interior with y.
Booklet: Co-interior angles on parallel lines:
$$\begin{align*}y+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=110^\circ\\x+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=110^\circ\end{align*}$$
Proposed: Co-interior angles on parallel lines. The left side and the rising line are cut by the base:
$$\begin{align*}x+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=110^\circ\end{align*}$$
The left side and the rising line are also cut by the right side, which meets the left side at the $40^\circ$ apex:
$$\begin{align*}y+40^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=140^\circ\end{align*}$$
Independent solve: x=110^\circ,\ y=110^\circ
